plan.title: Convert the five pack-migrate dispatch routes to native TypeScript (Phase 1)

narratives.Description: The pack-migrate-skills, -rules, -strategies, -patterns, and -swarm-spec verbs are still served by loadPythonScriptHandler routes in packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts (lines ~491-499), shelling into Python pack_migrate_*.py scripts. This story replaces those five routes with native TypeScript handlers so the pack-render surface no longer depends on bundled Python.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Implement native TypeScript pack-migrate handlers (skills, rules, strategies, patterns, swarm-spec) under packages/cli/src that reproduce the render/slice output contract of the current pack_migrate_*.py scripts.
- Replace the five loadPythonScriptHandler routes at dispatch.ts ~491-499 with the new native handlers and add dispatch tests asserting each verb routes to TypeScript rather than Python.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer running deft pack-migrate verbs, I want native TypeScript handlers, so that pack rendering works on a machine with no Python installed.

items.title: Given dispatch.ts, when the five pack-migrate verbs are dispatched, then each routes to a native TypeScript handler with no loadPythonScriptHandler call.

narrative.Acceptance: Given dispatch.ts, when the five pack-migrate verbs are dispatched, then each routes to a native TypeScript handler with no loadPythonScriptHandler call.

items.title: Given a TypeScript pack-migrate handler, when it renders a pack, then the emitted output matches the prior pack_migrate_*.py contract for the same input.
